title: Audio clip review: Fine / Flag / Imperfect
summary: Listen to short generated or recorded clips and give each a verdict; mark where faults are on the waveform. One click for the common case.
use_for: ASR or dictation audio spot checks

derived_from.origin: a tested audio review project on Label Studio 1.23

line.note: the text the clip should say, shown as the header

hint.note: where to listen; put '' if none

clip_id.note: your stable id, used by pull scripts

one_click.how: import each task with a Fine prediction

look: <Style> block in config.xml: coloured pill buttons for the verdict, green Submit. Targets Label Studio 1.23 class names (lsf-choice*, ant-checkbox*).
readback: A clip is flagged if verdict is Flag, or it has regions with Fine; Imperfect is kept and listed for a second round. Map your own rule in the pull step.
variants: drop the 'where' Labels for a pure verdict pass
rename fault labels to the domain (keep hotkeys 1-5)
multiple annotators: maximum_annotations 2+ and no pre-fill
